           BRACHYGLOTTIS REPENS

         Puka-Puka

        (BRACHYGLOTTIS)


Fluttering sensation   (  Caladium  ).
        Kidney and bladder symptoms predominate. Produces symptoms of albuminuria. Itching in ears
        and nostrils.   Bright's disease  . Oppression of chest.
        Writer's cramp.



Abdomen.--  Feeling as if something rolling about. Fluttering in
        region of ovary.



Urinary.--  Pressure in neck of bladder; urging to urinate.
        Sense of swashing in bladder. Soreness in urethra; feeling as if urine could not be
        retained. Urine contains mucous corpuscles and epithelium, albumen and casts.



Extremities.--  Cramp in fingers, thumb, and wrist when
        writing-soreness extending along flexor carpi ulnaris.



Relationship.--  Compare:   Apis;
        Helonias; Merc cor; Plumbum  .



Dose.--  Third potency.
